title: Chapter 439
text:
Is he pretending to have a split personality?

Everyone had a weird expression on their faces. Is this person crazy?

Han Xiao said in a deep voice, "Mind Host."

Hearing that, a look of surprise flashed across Fu Ding's eyes. He did not expect Han Xiao to be able to see through the truth.

"I didn't expect you to be able to tell." Fu Ding suddenly understood why Han Xiao had attacked him. It turned out that he had discovered Chen Xing's secret.

However, he was immediately confused. Why would this mercenary named Black Star help him? They were not related at all, and mercenaries were not warm-hearted people who liked to meddle in other people's business. There had to be some ulterior motive.

"So, it's Mind Host." The third Volga brother immediately explained to the others. He was also a Psychic and knew about this secret technique.

Just like how Pugilists trained their physique, Psychics trained their mind and soul. The strong could separate their soul and consciousness from their original body and host them in another life form's brain to obtain a second life.

Normally, this technique would only be used when one's body was severely injured and there was no way out. That was because the separation process would cause irreversible damage to the soul. Furthermore, there was only a three in a thousand chance of success. If it failed, the soul would collapse, and one would die on the spot.

Unless they had no other choice, most people would not be willing to give up their original body and replace it with someone else's. Chen Xing was an example. She was a woman, so how could she want to change into a man's body?

Psychics would never choose someone with a stronger mind than them as their host. Once a Mind Host possessed a body, it would basically be able to take control of the body. The original owner's consciousness would be trapped in a cage. They would be able to sense the body's senses, but they would not be able to control the body. They would be like a bystander, like two personalities that knew of each other's existence.

Chen Xing was severely injured, and her consciousness was very weak. She could only hide in her brain to recuperate. Therefore, Fu Ding naturally took over the body, and the bystander became Chen Xing.

Han Xiao attacked because he wanted to see Fu Ding. Injuring Chen Xing's consciousness was the most direct way. He happened to have Hella's Character Summon Card and could accurately deal with the mind. He did not need to injure Fu Ding's body to the brink of death, although his injuries were not light.

The third brother of the Volga family explained the principle of Spiritual Possession, and everyone understood.

No wonder Chen Xing behaved so femininely. She was originally a woman.

Herlous asked curiously, "When were you taken in?"

"You mean when was the last time I controlled my body?" Fu Ding shrugged. "Four years, nine months, fourteen days, eight hours, and twenty-three minutes. Oh, it's twenty-four minutes now."

"About five years ago." Sylvia had already woken up. After hearing the conversation, she asked in surprise, "Isn't that the day Morning Star debuted?"

"Yes. My hometown is in a remote Star System in the Shattered Star Ring. I did not like the main planet that had been completely modified, so I took the initiative to move to a desolate, semi-colonial planet to live. It was a place where the poor lived, and it was also a place of exile in the eyes of others. However, I felt that it was more lively than a city surrounded by steel. I lived in the wild, farming, and hunting for a living. Everything was so harmonious. One day, a spaceship crashed into my family's vegetable field. There was a severely injured and unconscious woman sitting inside. She was Chen Xing. I saved her and bandaged her wounds, but her injuries were too severe. When she was on the verge of death, she snatched my body and used it to continue living. She even became a celebrity. That's the whole story. "

Fu Ding's tone was calm. He did not seem to be very angry about his body being stolen. Five years had allowed him to get used to it, and the initial anger and resentment had been smoothed out.

Han Xiao nodded in his mind. Although Chen Xing could not fight back at all, that was because her psychic power had been severely damaged when her soul was taken away. Her strength had once been extremely close to Grade A, but because she had changed her body, her strength had plummeted, almost falling to Grade C. Thus, she had to collect sacrificial items to recover her strength.

Chen Xing was not a main character, but Fu Ding was.

Furthermore, his luck was even stronger than a small main character like Herlous. His Luck Glow was obviously Advanced.

Having a strong person living in his mind for no reason was definitely the standard for a main character. However, this person was an old grandpa, while Fu Ding was a young lady. People were just different.

Without Chen Xing, Fu Ding, who was like an old cadre with an idle personality, would definitely not take the initiative to discover his hidden talent. He would always be an ordinary person. Although Chen Xing had temporarily stolen his body, she had also brought him on an unknown journey. Otherwise, Fu Ding would never have discovered his boundless talent. His predicament was only temporary. Although Han Xiao did not know the exact time, Fu Ding had turned the tables and suppressed Chen Xing.

Fu Ding's personal growth history could be derived from his body. The legend of a storyline singer.

A main character with an Advanced Luck Glow was very impressive. Fu Ding at his peak was on the same level as Hella. His voice penetrated the soul and did not need air to transmit his voice. It sounded directly in one's heart.

Using his ethereal voice to wash away those angry, impetuous, and vengeful souls was like a misty wind passing through the forest or a droplet of water ruffling the surface of a lake. Everything was magnificent, but in the end, it would return to calmness, leaving behind only the peaceful joy of seeing tender grass stubbornly breaking through the soil.

A song resolved an interstellar war that was about to break out.

This was what Fu Ding was famous for.

Furthermore, Fu Ding did not keep it to himself and openly taught his Psychic skills. Psychic players could learn to use their Psychic skills through singing from him and form a school. Fu Ding was equivalent to an Advanced Psychic teacher.

When Han Xiao thought of this mission, he had already made a full plan. If he could get the Mission Completion Card, then he would not provoke Chen Xing for the time being and advance first. However, if he could not get the Mission Completion Card, then he would trigger this storyline. In his previous life, the players who were looking for the statue naturally did not know about Chen Xing's secret. It was a long time later that the players found out about this character's storyline. It was a pity that no one was able to trigger it at that time.

Although Han Xiao did not know the result of triggering this storyline at this time, he decided to give it a try. He was not completely clueless. He had some understanding of Fu Ding's later behavior and personality, so he could roughly guess the process. He did not dare to say that he was 100% sure, but it would definitely be beneficial.

"I can help you control your body and expel the guest in your brain. Otherwise, when she recovers, your body will belong to her again," Han Xiao said.

Fu Ding was indifferent. "What do you want? I believe this is not free help."

"Chen Xing is very rich. You are her twin, so you must know her account password. I want her savings," Han Xiao said after thinking for a while.

Chen Xing was indeed very rich and was a piece of fatty meat, but this was not Han Technician's main goal. However, he could not just say that he had taken a fancy to Fu Ding's potential. That would not win the other party's trust. Saying that he was after money was more convincing, and only then would Fu Ding lower his guard.

After all, the body was still Fu Ding's. He would rather let Chen Xing control it than take the risk.

Fu Ding immediately believed him. Mercenaries seeking money was a matter of course. Moreover, this was not considered kidnapping. Instead, it was helping a person who was being possessed. It did not violate the mercenary's contract.

Fu Ding felt that this was a good idea. Although the money was earned by Chen Xing, she was using his body. He did not feel any psychological burden when squandering money.

"Sounds good, but if you want to get the money immediately, I'm afraid I can't help you."

Pointing at his head, Fu Ding smiled bitterly. "She just threatened me. If I touch her savings, she will take me down with her. So, before dealing with her problem, I can't afford to pay you."

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. When he made this request, he had already guessed Chen Xing's possible reaction. This result was exactly what he wanted. He was secretly happy and nodded. "Then you have to stay by my side. I can help you suppress Chen Xing's counterattack at any time until we find a way to completely get rid of her."

Feidin paused and said, "I hope not to harm her life. She had no choice but to host my body. She didn't use my body to mess around. In the past five years, although she found me annoying and blocked my voice in her brain, I've seen her memories. She's also a pitiful person."

If an ordinary person had their body snatched away, they would most likely want the host body to be annihilated. However, as a main character, Feidin's personality was clearly not ordinary. Everyone was surprised that he could still consider the Morning Star in such a situation.

"Okay."

Han Xiao nodded. On the surface, he seemed to have a card up his sleeve. In reality, he did not know how to deal with Spirit Possession. No player had triggered this storyline before, so he could only figure it out himself. However, this did not prevent him from agreeing.

"Since we have reached a consensus, we need you to solve our current predicament. As long as you appear, our wanted list can be canceled."

"No problem." Fu Ding smiled gently. He looked at his bruised and swollen face in the mirror and said, "But I have to deal with the injuries on my face first. Otherwise, it won't be convincing at all."
